body: Session 4 resumes existing #2660 and has read/accepted non-nested-root ruling. One exact guard execution fork remains: fixed oracle PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin excludes guard directory; existing guards detect host fallback only by PATH interception. Unmodified helper cannot overlay a guard at a system-tool path (source==destination binds). With the fixed PATH, bare required-tool calls resolve installed host tools and can produce clean=true without any guard event. Please rule: allow immutable guard directory before the fixed system entries (no prefix/trial entries), or replace fallback detection with another explicit oracle-author contract. I will not silently weaken the guard requirement. Meanwhile implementing/probing approved non-nested root and snapshot primitives only.
subject: TASK-1730 narrow guard/PATH contract fork
